steps.comment: OPTIONAL dedicated StoreFront callback vserver callback.example.org (internal only)
steps.note: StoreFront validates Gateway logins by calling https://<callback URL>/CitrixAuthService/AuthService.asmx. A separate ICA-only vserver keeps that internal path off the public Gateway (useful with mTLS / client certificates on the public vserver, which StoreFront cannot present). The Gateway session table is global: no authentication or session policy is needed here. StoreFront: Gateway entry 'Callback URL' = https://callback.example.org; DNS callback.example.org -> 10.0.20.13 (internal).
StoreFront must trust this certificate (public CA or an internal CA rolled out to the StoreFront servers).

A plain GET (browser, Invoke-WebRequest) on /CitrixAuthService/AuthService.asmx is closed by the NetScaler on EVERY Gateway vserver, also on working ones - it proves nothing. Test with a real Gateway login and check the Citrix Delivery Services event log on StoreFront (Citrix Authentication Service errors). TLS only: Test-NetConnection callback.example.org -Port 443
